input.query: SELECT platform, doc_type, CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-01' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, SUM(n_decisions) n, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_approved)*1.0/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
